## About Dr. Jash Ajmera

Dr. Jash Ajmera is a trusted psychiatrist in Surat, specializing in personalized, evidence-based mental health care. He holds an M.B.B.S. and a D.P.M. (Diploma in Psychological Medicine / Psychiatry) and has 7+ years of clinical experience. Since 2017 he has been actively involved in the National Mental Health Programme and community mental-health outreach across Gujarat, with a mission to make quality psychiatric services accessible to all. He also conducts mental-health workshops for NGOs and corporates.

His clinical philosophy — "No Health Without Mental Health" — centers on neuroscience-driven, empathetic care that integrates psychotherapy with safe, effective medication, tailored to each individual, and delivered with strict confidentiality.

## Services and conditions treated

The clinic provides diagnosis, therapy and medication management for a wide range of psychiatric and psychological conditions:

- **Depression & mood disorders** — assessment and treatment of major depression, persistent low mood and related mood disorders.
- **Anxiety disorders** — generalized anxiety, panic attacks, phobias and social anxiety.
- **Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD)** — evidence-based therapy and medication.
- **Bipolar disorder** — mood stabilization and long-term management.
- **Schizophrenia & psychosis** — diagnosis, medication and psychosocial support.
- **Addiction & de-addiction** — alcohol, tobacco and substance-use treatment.
- **Personality disorders** — assessment and structured therapy.
- **Psychosexual disorders** — confidential evaluation and treatment.
- **Sleep disorders & stress** — insomnia and stress-related conditions.
- **Child & adolescent mental health** — developmental and behavioural concerns.

Treatment approach: evidence-based methods combining psychotherapy (counselling, CBT and related techniques) with safe, clinically indicated medication, customized to each patient. All consultations and records are kept strictly confidential.
